sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: School is a great place for learning.
sentences.ipa: /skˈuːl ɪz ə grˈeɪt plˈeɪs fɔː lˈɜːnɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 学校是学习的好地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: read about Sunshine Middle School;
sentences.meaning: 阅读关于阳光中学的内容；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn about different places at school;
sentences.meaning: 了解学校里的不同场所；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: introduce our school;
sentences.meaning: 介绍我们的学校；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: get to know our school better.
sentences.meaning: 更了解我们的学校

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We are at a new school now.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː ɑː æt ə njˈuː skˈuːl nˈaʊ./
sentences.meaning: 我们现在在一所新学校。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s learn about different places at our school and discuss them with each other.
sentences.ipa: /lˈets lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt dˈɪfərənt plˈeɪsɪz æt ˌaʊə skˈuːl ænd dɪskˈʌs ðˌem wɪð ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə./
sentences.meaning: 让我们了解学校里的不同场所，并互相讨论。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Places at school
sentences.meaning: 校园场所

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A The Class 1, Grade 7 students are listening to an introduction to Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /ə ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən stjˈuːdnts ɑː lˈɪsənɪŋ tə ən ˌɪntrədˈʌkʃən tə sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 一年级一年级，七年级学生正在听阳光中学的介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Listen and tick the places you hear.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɪsən ænd tˈɪk ðə plˈeɪsɪz juː hˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 听好，打勾你听到的地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: gym
sentences.meaning: 体育馆

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: classroom building
sentences.meaning: 教学楼

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: sports field
sentences.meaning: 运动场

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: dining hall
sentences.meaning: 食堂

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: library
sentences.meaning: 图书馆

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: lab
sentences.meaning: 实验室

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie and her primary school classmate Kate are talking about their new schools.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː mˈɪliː ænd hɜː prˈaɪməriː skˈuːl klˈɑːsmeɪt kˈeɪt ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðeə njˈuː skˈuːlz./
sentences.meaning: B·米莉和她的小学同学凯特在谈论他们的新学校。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Imagine you meet a friend from another school.
sentences.ipa: /ɪmˈædʒɪn juː mˈiːt ə frˈend frɒm ənˈʌðə skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 想象一下你会遇到另一个学校的朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bɪlˈəʊ æz ə mˈɒdəl./
sentences.meaning: 以下面的对话为示范。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Role-play in pairs.
sentences.meaning: 角色扮演双人游戏。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Hello, Kate. It’s good to see you.
sentences.ipa: /həlˈəʊ, kˈeɪt. ˌɪts gˈʊd tə sˈiː juː./
sentences.meaning: 你好，凯特，很高兴见到你

sentences.speaker: kate
sentences.text: Hi, Millie. Nice to see you too! How’s your new school?
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, mˈɪliː. nˈaɪs tə sˈiː juː tˈuː! hˌaʊz jɔː njˈuː skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 嗨，米莉，很高兴见到你！

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: It’s great. The best part is the modern library. Does your school have a library?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪts grˈeɪt. ðə bˈest pˈɑːt ɪz ðə mˈɒdən lˈaɪbrəriː. dˈʌz jɔː skˈuːl hæv ə lˈaɪbrəriː?/
sentences.meaning: 这很好，最好的部分是现代图书馆。你的学校有图书馆吗？

sentences.speaker: kate
sentences.text: Yes, it does. We have a nice dining hall as well.
sentences.ipa: /jˈes, ɪt dˈʌz. wˌiː hæv ə nˈaɪs dˈaɪnɪŋ hˈɔːl æz wˈel./
sentences.meaning: 是的，我们还有一间不错的餐厅

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Cool! My school has a big dining hall too.
sentences.ipa: /kˈuːl! mˌaɪ skˈuːl hæz ə bˈɪg dˈaɪnɪŋ hˈɔːl tˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 酷，我的学校也有一个大餐厅

sentences.speaker: kate
sentences.text: How many classrooms does your school have?
sentences.ipa: /hˌaʊ mˈeniː klˈɑːsruːmz dˈʌz jɔː skˈuːl hˈæv?/
sentences.meaning: 你学校有多少间教室？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: It has 36 classrooms. They’re all bright and clean.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt hæz θˈɜːtiː sˈɪks klˈɑːsruːmz. ðˌeə ˈɔːl brˈaɪt ænd klˈiːn./
sentences.meaning: 学校有36间教室，都是明亮干净的。

sentences.speaker: kate
sentences.text: That’s a lot! My school only has 18. My school is not big but it’s great. I love it.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈæts ə lˈɒt! mˌaɪ skˈuːl ˈəʊnliː hæz ˌeɪtˈiːn. mˌaɪ skˈuːl ɪz nˌɒt bˈɪg bˌʌt ɪts grˈeɪt. ˌaɪ lˈʌv ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 我学校只有18所， 学校不是大学校，但很棒。我喜欢它。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What other places does a school have?
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː wˌɒt ˈʌðə plˈeɪsɪz dˈʌz ə skˈuːl hˈæv?/
sentences.meaning: C 学校还有其他什么地方？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Talk with your partner.
sentences.meaning: 跟你搭档谈谈

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our wonderful school
sentences.meaning: 我们的好学校

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie wants to learn more about Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪliː wˈɒnts tə lˈɜːn mˈɔː əbˈaʊt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 米莉想更多地了解阳光中学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She is watching a short video on the school website.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˌiː ɪz wˈɒtʃɪŋ ə ʃˈɔːt vˈɪdɪəʊ ˌɒn ðə skˈuːl wˈebsaɪt./
sentences.meaning: 她正在观看学校网站上的一段短视频。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪfˈɔː rˈiːdɪŋ, θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here is the video script.
sentences.meaning: 这是录像剧本。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We often begin a welcome speech with a friendly opener, such as “Hello” or “Welcome...”.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː ˈɒfən bɪgˈɪn ə wˈelkəm spˈiːtʃ wɪð ə frˈendliː ˈəʊpənə, sˈʌtʃ æz “həlˈəʊ” ɔː “wˈelkəm...”./
sentences.meaning: 我们经常以友好的开场白，例如“你好”或“欢迎......”。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What places should a school have?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt plˈeɪsɪz ʃˌʊd ə skˈuːl hˈæv?/
sentences.meaning: 1 学校应该有哪个地方？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Why are green spaces important for a school?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌaɪ ɑː grˈiːn spˈeɪsɪz ɪmpˈɔːtənt fɔː ə skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 2为什么绿色空间对学校很重要？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Hello, everyone!
sentences.meaning: 大家好，你们好！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I’m Jack Liu from Grade 9.
sentences.meaning: 我是九年级的刘杰克

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Welcome to our school!
sentences.meaning: 欢迎来到我们的学校！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here are our classroom buildings and our modern library.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə ɑː ˌaʊə klˈɑːsruːm bˈɪldɪŋz ænd ˌaʊə mˈɒdən lˈaɪbrəriː./
sentences.meaning: 这是我们的教室建筑和我们的现代图书馆。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They’re the perfect places for us to study.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌeə ðə pˈɜːfɪkt plˈeɪsɪz fɔː ˌʌs tə stˈʌdiː./
sentences.meaning: 他们是我们学习的绝佳场所。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our school has lots of green spaces.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊə skˈuːl hæz lˈɒts ɒv grˈiːn spˈeɪsɪz./
sentences.meaning: 我们的学校有很多绿地

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Students enjoy spending time here.
sentences.meaning: 学生们享受在这里度过的时间。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Sometimes we chat with teachers about our problems here too.
sentences.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz wiː tʃˈæt wɪð tˈiːtʃəz əbˈaʊt ˌaʊə prˈɒbləmz hˈɪə tˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 有时我们也会和老师讨论我们的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have a great sports field.
sentences.meaning: 我们有一个伟大的运动场。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Can you see the students running there?
sentences.ipa: /kˌæn juː sˈiː ðə stjˈuːdnts rˈʌnɪŋ ðˈeə?/
sentences.meaning: 你能看见那些学生在那里跑吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Lots of exciting sports matches take place on it.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɒts ɒv ɪksˈaɪtɪŋ spˈɔːts mˈætʃɪz tˈeɪk plˈeɪs ˌɒn ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 上面有很多令人兴奋的体育比赛。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the school noticeboards near the gate.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʊk æt ðə skˈuːl nˈəʊtɪsbɔːdz nˌɪə ðə gˈeɪt./
sentences.meaning: 看看大门附近的学校告示牌。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here we can read about school news and stories of star students and teachers.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə wiː kæn rˈiːd əbˈaʊt skˈuːl njˈuːz ænd stˈɔːriːz ɒv stˈɑː stjˈuːdnts ænd tˈiːtʃəz./
sentences.meaning: 在这里，我们可以读到关于学校的新闻和明星学生和教师的故事。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They’re role models for us.
sentences.meaning: 他们是我们的榜样。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The boards also show students’ works, like paintings and photos.
sentences.ipa: /ðə bˈɔːdz ˈɔːlsəʊ ʃˈəʊ stjˈuːdnts” wˈɜːks, lˈaɪk pˈeɪntɪŋz ænd fˈəʊtəʊz./
sentences.meaning: 这些板子还展示学生的作品，如绘画和照片。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Come and enjoy your school life here.
sentences.ipa: /kˈʌm ænd ɪndʒˈɔɪ jɔː skˈuːl lˈaɪf hˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 来享受你的学校生活吧

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You’ll find more great places.
sentences.meaning: 你会找到更多的好地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Trust me!
sentences.meaning: 相信我！ ！相信我！相信我！相信我！相信我！相信我！相信我！相信我！相信我！相信我，相信我，相信我！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Fill in the places talked about in the video script.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɪl ɪn ðə plˈeɪsɪz tˈɔːkt əbˈaʊt ɪn ðə vˈɪdɪəʊ skrˈɪpt./
sentences.meaning: 填写视频剧本中讲到的地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Here is a picture of Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /ə hˈɪə ɪz ə pˈɪktʃə ɒv sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: A Here是阳光中学的照片。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie made some notes from the video.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː mˈɪliː mˌeɪd sˌʌm nˈəʊts frɒm ðə vˈɪdɪəʊ./
sentences.meaning: B米莉在视频中做了一些笔记。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Help her complete the notes below.
sentences.meaning: 帮助她完成下面的笔记。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: problems
sentences.meaning: 问题

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete her email with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt hɜː ˈiːmeɪl wɪð ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə wˈɜːdz ænd frˈeɪzɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 填写她的电子邮件，并填写以下框中文字和短语的正确形式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Millie is writing an email to her online friend Liu Yi about her new school.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː mˈɪliː ɪz rˈaɪtɪŋ ən ˈiːmeɪl tə hɜː ɒnlˈaɪn frˈend jˌɪ əbˈaʊt hɜː njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: C Milie正给网友刘毅写一封关于她新学校的邮件。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Liu Yi
sentences.meaning: 刘毅

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My new school
sentences.meaning: 我的新学校

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Hello Liu Yi,
sentences.meaning: 刘毅，你好！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: How are you doing?
sentences.meaning: 你好吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want to tell you about my new school.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ wˈɒnt tə tˈel juː əbˈaʊt maɪ njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 我想告诉你我的新学校

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: really great place.
sentences.meaning: 不错的地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: love to study there.
sentences.meaning: 爱在那里学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: sports there.
sentences.meaning: 运动在那里。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Sometimes I watch the matches.
sentences.meaning: 有时候我看火柴。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There is school news on them.
sentences.meaning: 他们有学校新闻。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: can also read about star students and learn a lot from them.
sentences.ipa: /kæn ˈɔːlsəʊ rˈiːd əbˈaʊt stˈɑː stjˈuːdnts ænd lˈɜːn ə lˈɒt frɒm ðˌem./
sentences.meaning: 也可以读到明星学生，从他们那里学到很多东西。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What is your new school like?
sentences.meaning: 你的新学校是什么样子的？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Tell me about it!
sentences.meaning: 告诉我！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Talk soon,
sentences.meaning: 一会儿再说吧

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Wang Xinyue
sentences.meaning: 王新远

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.
sentences.meaning: D 考虑以下问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.
sentences.meaning: 与同学分享答案。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What do you like about Sunshine Middle School?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk əbˈaʊt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 1你喜欢阳光中学吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What place at your school do you like best?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt plˈeɪs æt jɔː skˈuːl dˈuː juː lˈaɪk bˈest?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你最喜欢哪个学校？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why?
sentences.meaning: 为什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 How is your new school different from Sunshine Middle School?
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː hˌaʊ ɪz jɔː njˈuː skˈuːl dˈɪfərənt frɒm sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 3，你的新学校与阳光中学有何不同？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Jack Liu is showing some new students around the school.
sentences.ipa: /dʒˈæk ɪz ʃˈəʊɪŋ sˌʌm njˈuː stjˈuːdnts ərˈaʊnd ðə skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 刘杰克正在学校周围展示一些新学生。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read his introduction below and pay attention to the use of personal pronouns.
sentences.ipa: /rˈiːd hɪz ˌɪntrədˈʌkʃən bɪlˈəʊ ænd pˈeɪ ətˈenʃən tə ðə jˈuːs ɒv pˈɜːsənəl prˈəʊnaʊnz./
sentences.meaning: 以下阅读他的介绍，注意使用个人代词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You can find all the teachers for Grade 7 here.
sentences.ipa: /jˌuː kæn fˈaɪnd ˈɔːl ðə tˈiːtʃəz fɔː grˈeɪd sˈevən hˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 你可以在这里找到所有7年级的老师。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Hello, everyone!
sentences.meaning: 大家好，你们好！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the noticeboard.
sentences.meaning: 看看那个告示板

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He teaches English.
sentences.meaning: 他教英语。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This is Mr Wu.
sentences.meaning: 这位是吴先生

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And this is Ms Lin.
sentences.meaning: 这位是林小姐

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They're both kind and helpful.
sentences.meaning: 他们既善良又有帮助。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She's a Music teacher.
sentences.meaning: 她是一个音乐老师。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have many nice teachers like them.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv mˈeniː nˈaɪs tˈiːtʃəz lˈaɪk ðˌem./
sentences.meaning: 我们有很多像他们这样的好老师。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with the correct personal pronouns.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Yes, and our classmates are friendly.
sentences.meaning: 是的，我们的同学是友好的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Mr Wu asked the Class 1, Grade 7 students to write an email to a friend about their new school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː mˈɪstə wuː ˈɑːskt ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən stjˈuːdnts tə rˈaɪt ən ˈiːmeɪl tə ə frˈend əbˈaʊt ðeə njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 吴先生请一年级七年级的学生给朋友写一封关于他们新学校的电子邮件。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D1 Answer the questions below with the information about your school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː wˈʌn ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ wɪð ðiː ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: D1 以有关你学校的资料来回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What is your school like?
sentences.meaning: 你的学校是怎样的？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What does your school have?
sentences.meaning: 2，你学校有什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Put a tick (3) in the box.
sentences.meaning: 在盒子里放个勾子(3)。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What is your favourite place at your school?
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː wˌɒt ɪz jɔː fˈeɪvərɪt plˈeɪs æt jɔː skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 三，你最喜欢的学校是什么位置？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 What do you do in your favourite place?
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː wˌɒt dˈuː juː dˈuː ɪn jɔː fˈeɪvərɪt plˈeɪs?/
sentences.meaning: 四，你最喜欢的地方做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 What are your teachers and classmates like?
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv wˌɒt ɑː jɔː tˈiːtʃəz ænd klˈɑːsmeɪts lˈaɪk?/
sentences.meaning: 5，你的老师和同学是什么样的人？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 What do you think of your school?
sentences.ipa: /sˈɪks wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɒv jɔː skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 6，你觉得你的学校怎么样？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D2 Millie sent an email to her online friend Liu Yi and received her reply.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː tˈuː mˈɪliː sˈent ən ˈiːmeɪl tə hɜː ɒnlˈaɪn frˈend jˌɪ ænd rɪsˈiːvd hɜː rɪplˈaɪ./
sentences.meaning: D2米莉发电子邮件给她的网络朋友刘毅，并收到了她的答复。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read it with her.
sentences.meaning: 跟她一起读吧

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We often begin with “Dear...”
sentences.meaning: 我们经常从“亲爱的...”开始。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: and end with “Best wishes” in an email or letter to friends or family members.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ˈend wɪð “bˈest wˈɪʃɪz” ɪn ən ˈiːmeɪl ɔː lˈetə tə frˈendz ɔː fˈæmɪliː mˈembəz./
sentences.meaning: 并在给朋友或家庭成员的电子邮件或信件中以“最佳愿望”结束。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A formal email follows the same structure, greeting and sign-off as a formal letter.
sentences.ipa: /ə fˈɔːməl ˈiːmeɪl fˈɒləʊz ðə sˈeɪm strˈʌktʃə, grˈiːtɪŋ ænd sˈaɪnˌɒf æz ə fˈɔːməl lˈetə./
sentences.meaning: 正式的电子邮件采用与正式信件相同的结构、问候和签收。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Dear Xinyue,
sentences.meaning: 亲爱的欣悦：

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Opening
sentences.meaning: A. 开幕

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Thanks for your email.
sentences.meaning: 谢谢你的邮件。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am at a new school now too.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm æt ə njˈuː skˈuːl nˈaʊ tˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 我现在也在一所新学校

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The school is old, but I like it.
sentences.ipa: /ðə skˈuːl ɪz ˈəʊld, bˌʌt ˌaɪ lˈaɪk ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 学校已经老了，但是我喜欢

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My favourite place at school is the hall.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ fˈeɪvərɪt plˈeɪs æt skˈuːl ɪz ðə hˈɔːl./
sentences.meaning: 我在学校最喜欢的地方是大厅。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have meetings there, and a lot of interesting events take place there.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv mˈiːtɪŋz ðˈeə, ænd ə lˈɒt ɒv ˈɪntrɪstɪŋ ɪvˈents tˈeɪk plˈeɪs ðˈeə./
sentences.meaning: 我们在那里开会，那里也举行了许多有趣的活动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My new friends and I often play ping-pong together there.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ njˈuː frˈendz ænd ˌaɪ ˈɒfən plˈeɪ pˈɪŋpɒŋ təgˈeðə ðˈeə./
sentences.meaning: 我和新朋友经常在那里打乒乓球

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We also have a playground.
sentences.meaning: 我们还有一个游乐场。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We do not have a gym, but we have a football field.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː dˈuː nˌɒt hæv ə dʒˈɪm, bˌʌt wiː hæv ə fˈʊtbɔːl fˈiːld./
sentences.meaning: 我们没有体育馆，但我们有足球场。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We love playing football on it.
sentences.meaning: 我们喜欢在上面玩橄榄球

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Main body
sentences.meaning: 主要机构

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our teachers are quite nice.
sentences.meaning: 我们的老师都很好

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My classmates are great too.
sentences.meaning: 我的同学也很棒

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They care about us a lot.
sentences.meaning: 他们很关心我们

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They are friendly and helpful.
sentences.meaning: 他们是友好和有帮助的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our school is not large, but it is a special place for me.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊə skˈuːl ɪz nˌɒt lˈɑːdʒ, bˌʌt ɪt ɪz ə spˈeʃl plˈeɪs fɔː mˌiː./
sentences.meaning: 我们的学校不是很大，但它对我来说是一个特殊的地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am happy to be a student here.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm hˈæpiː tə biː ə stjˈuːdnt hˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 我很高兴在这里成为一名学生。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Best wishes,
sentences.meaning: 祝你们好意

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Closing
sentences.meaning: 闭幕

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Liu Yi
sentences.meaning: 刘毅

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D3 Write an email to your friend about your new school based on the information in Part D1.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θrˈiː rˈaɪt ən ˈiːmeɪl tə jɔː frˈend əbˈaʊt jɔː njˈuː skˈuːl bˈeɪst ˌɒn ðiː ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ɪn pˈɑːt dˈiː wˈʌn./
sentences.meaning: D3根据D1部分的信息，写一封电子邮件给你的朋友，介绍你的新学校。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use Liu Yi’s email as a model.
sentences.meaning: 以刘毅的电子邮件为模范。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My/Our school has …
sentences.meaning: 我们的学校..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have/do not have a playground/library/hall/…
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv dˈuː nˌɒt hæv ə plˈeɪgraʊnd lˈaɪbrəriː hˈɔːl…/
sentences.meaning: 我们有/没有游乐场/图书馆/大厅/。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There is a playground/library/hall/…
sentences.meaning: 设有游乐场/图书馆/大厅/。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The playground/library/hall is …
sentences.meaning: 游乐场/图书馆/大厅是。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: and …
sentences.meaning: 还有..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We do not have …, but we have …
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː dˈuː nˌɒt hˈæv …, bˌʌt wiː hˈæv …/
sentences.meaning: 我们没有...但我们有..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are …
sentences.meaning: 还有..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: classrooms in …

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My favourite place at school is …
sentences.meaning: 我在学校最喜欢的地方是..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The teachers/students are nice/friendly/...
sentences.meaning: 老师/学生是好人/友善人/。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 I can describe the places at Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn ˌaɪ kæn dɪskrˈaɪb ðə plˈeɪsɪz æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 1，我可以描述阳光中学的那些地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 I can use different forms of personal pronouns correctly.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː ˌaɪ kæn jˈuːz dˈɪfərənt fˈɔːmz ɒv pˈɜːsənəl prˈəʊnaʊnz kərˈektliː./
sentences.meaning: 2，我可以正确使用不同形式的个人代词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 I can introduce my school and talk about what I like about it with the new words in this unit.
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː ˌaɪ kæn ˌɪntrədjˈuːs maɪ skˈuːl ænd tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt wˌɒt ˌaɪ lˈaɪk əbˈaʊt ɪt wɪð ðə njˈuː wˈɜːdz ɪn ðɪs jˈuːnɪt./
sentences.meaning: 3，我可以介绍我的学校，用这个单位的新字来谈谈我喜欢什么。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: /G/, /h/, /m/, /n/, /N/, /l/, /r/, /j/ and /w/ correctly in words.
sentences.ipa: /dʒˈiː, ˈeɪtʃ, ˈem, ˈen, ˈen, ˈel, ˈɑː, dʒˈeɪ ænd dˈʌbəljuː kərˈektliː ɪn wˈɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 I know the places at my school better.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv ˌaɪ nˈəʊ ðə plˈeɪsɪz æt maɪ skˈuːl bˈetə./
sentences.meaning: 5，我更了解我学校的地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: * Assess your learning of new words and grammar by doing the exercises on page 112.
sentences.ipa: /əsˈes jɔː lˈɜːnɪŋ ɒv njˈuː wˈɜːdz ænd grˈæmə baɪ dˈuːɪŋ ðiː ˈeksəsaɪzɪz ˌɒn pˈeɪdʒ wˈʌn hˈʌndrəd twˈelv./
sentences.meaning: *通过第112页的练习来评估你对新词和语法的学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am good at.
sentences.meaning: 我擅长。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need to spend more time on.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ nˈiːd tə spˈend mˈɔː tˈaɪm ˌɒn./
sentences.meaning: 我需要花更多的时间。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Mountain in Hunan Province.
sentences.meaning: 湖南省境内山。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: is more than 1,000 years old.
sentences.ipa: /ɪz mˈɔː ðən wˈʌn θˈaʊzənd jˈɪəz ˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 已经超过1000年了

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: many other old schools in China.
sentences.meaning: 中国其他许多老学校。

sentences.text: one and share it with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn ænd ʃˈeə ɪt wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 一，与同学分享。
